text.p: Winnipeg Commodity Exchange canola and grain futures pre-opening call as of 0850 CDT.

CANOLA - C$0.50-C$1.00 lower. Follow-through selling from Thursday expected, plus pressure from expected one to two cent lower opening in CBOT soybeans. Canada's dollar was stronger overnight at C$1.3835 versus the U.S. dollar and rose against the yen to 91.61.
FLAX - C$0.50 lower. Should follow canola and CBOT soybeans.
WESTERN BARLEY - steady to C$0.50 lower. Commercial selling after Thursday's gains expected.
Five contracts delivered against the May supportive, 50 were expected.
FEED WHEAT - C$0.50 lower on expected lower CBOT corn and wheat futures markets and weak close Thursday.
(All values in Canadian dollars/tonne except peas, oats)
